## Constitution Compliance Checklist

### Code Quality Standards
- [ ] CHK001 TypeScript strict mode enabled and configured
- [ ] CHK002 Component hierarchy follows atoms → molecules → organisms → pages
- [ ] CHK003 Multitenant isolation implemented with tenant_id in all queries
- [ ] CHK004 JSDoc comments added for complex components
- [ ] CHK005 Domain models use meaningful names (Organization, Project, Template, etc.)

### Testing Standards
- [ ] CHK006 Unit tests cover critical business logic and tenant isolation
- [ ] CHK007 Integration tests validate AI document generation flow
- [ ] CHK008 E2E tests cover complete user journey
- [ ] CHK009 Claude API calls properly mocked in tests
- [ ] CHK010 Document versioning thoroughly tested

### User Experience Consistency
- [ ] CHK011 Minimalist interface design maintained
- [ ] CHK012 Consistent spacing system (4px, 8px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px) used
- [ ] CHK013 Typography hierarchy clear with 16px minimum body text
- [ ] CHK014 Progressive disclosure implemented for complex features
- [ ] CHK015 WCAG AA accessibility standards met (4.5:1 contrast ratio)

### Performance Requirements
- [ ] CHK017 Page load times under 3 seconds verified

- [ ] CHK020 Database queries use proper indexing on tenant_id/project_id
- [ ] CHK021 Bundle size remains under 500KB for initial load

### Security & Multitenant Isolation
- [ ] CHK023 PostgreSQL RLS policies implemented and tested
- [ ] CHK024 Audit logs capture all document changes with user_id/timestamp
- [ ] CHK025 Input validation occurs before all AI API calls
- [ ] CHK026 Environment variables used for sensitive configurations
- [ ] CHK027 HTTPS enforced in production
- [ ] CHK028 Rate limiting per tenant implemented
